title: [Shopify] Preserve tax match after rate conflict
summary: Shopify order processing now preserves tax mappings and holds document creation when a tax rate conflict occurs, rather than rolling back changes on error, allowing merchants to review and resolve the conflict.
key_points: Tax rate conflicts are treated as intentional processing holds instead of exceptions
Successful tax area and jurisdiction mappings persist when conflicts occur
Orders remain unprocessed without creating a Sales Document, keeping the Review Tax Match recovery action available
The internal OnBeforeCreateSalesHeader event can now return an intentional hold message
Behavior applies consistently to both manual and automatic order processing
quote: The order retains successful mappings and tax-match state, remains unprocessed with the existing guidance message, and no Sales Document is created.
